entries.heading: STUDY ON IMPACT OF ELECTRIC VEHICLES
ancestors: TITLE IV—ENABLING ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENT AND DATA COLLECTION
entries.text:
SEC. 40435. STUDY ON IMPACT OF ELECTRIC 
                            VEHICLES.

    Not later than 120 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the 
Secretary shall conduct, and submit to Congress a report describing the 
results of, a study on the cradle to grave environmental impact of 
electric vehicles.
